															UPSC Engineering Services 2026 Exam Pattern / Syllabus

															1. Preliminary Examination Pattern:-

															Paper I: General Studies and Engineering Aptitude

															
																Type: Objective Type (Multiple Choice Questions)
																Duration: 2 hours
																Marks: 200
																Subjects: General Studies,  Engineering Mathematics, Engineering Aptitude
															

															Paper II: Engineering Discipline

															
																Type: Objective Type (Multiple Choice Questions)
																Duration: 3 hours
																Marks: 300
																Subjects: Questions are specific to the engineering discipline chosen by the candidate (Civil, Mechanical, Electrical, or Electronics & Telecommunication).
															

															2. Main Examination Pattern:- 

															Paper I: Engineering Discipline

															
																Type: Conventional (Descriptive)
																Duration: 3 hours
																Marks: 300
																Subjects: Detailed questions specific to the chosen engineering discipline.
															

															Paper II: Engineering Discipline

															
																Type: Conventional (Descriptive)
																Duration: 3 hours
																Marks: 300
																Subjects: Further detailed questions specific to the chosen engineering discipline.
															

															3. Interview/Personality Test

															Pattern:

															
																Type: Personal Interview
																Duration: About 200 marks
																Purpose: To assess the candidate’s overall personality, communication skills, and suitability for a career in the engineering services.
															

															Syllabus Overview:-

															Preliminary Examination Syllabus:

															General Studies and Engineering Aptitude:

															
																Current Affairs
																General Science
																Logical Reasoning and Analytical Ability
																Engineering Mathematics
																Basic Engineering Knowledge
															

															Engineering Discipline Paper:

															
																Civil Engineering: Building Materials, Structural Analysis, Concrete Technology, Geotechnical Engineering, Transportation Engineering, Environmental Engineering, etc.
																Mechanical Engineering: Engineering Mechanics, Thermodynamics, Fluid Mechanics, Strength of Materials, Machine Design, Production Engineering, etc.
																Electrical Engineering: Electrical Circuits, Electrical Machines, Power Systems, Control Systems, Electrical and Electronic Measurements, etc.
																Electronics & Telecommunication Engineering: Electronic Devices, Communication Systems, Analog Circuits, Digital Circuits, Signal Processing, etc.
															

															Main Examination Syllabus:

															
																Engineering Discipline Papers:
															

															
																Civil Engineering: Detailed aspects of topics covered in the Preliminary Exam, including advanced concepts and problem-solving.
																Mechanical Engineering: In-depth study of mechanical systems, advanced topics in design, thermodynamics, and manufacturing.
																Electrical Engineering: Advanced topics in electrical systems, machines, power distribution, and control.
																Electronics & Telecommunication Engineering: Advanced electronics, communication theory, and digital systems.
															

															Preparation Tips:

															
																Understand the Syllabus: Thoroughly review the syllabus for both preliminary and main exams.
																Use Standard Textbooks: Refer to standard textbooks and reference materials relevant to your engineering discipline.
																Practice Previous Papers: Solve previous years' question papers to get an idea of the exam pattern and question types.
																Stay Updated: Keep abreast of current affairs and general knowledge topics.
																For the most accurate and detailed syllabus, consult the official UPSC notification and syllabus documents.

																Marks: 300

															Paper I: Engineering Discipline

															
																Type: Conventional (Descriptive)
																Duration: 3 hours
																Marks: 300

																Type: Conventional (Descriptive)

																Marks: 300
																Subjects: Further detailed questions specific to the chosen engineering discipline.

															UPSC Engineering Services 2026 Exam Pattern / Syllabus

															1. Preliminary Examination Pattern:-

															Paper I: General Studies and Engineering Aptitude

															
																Type: Objective Type (Multiple Choice Questions)
																Duration: 2 hours
																Marks: 200
																Subjects: General Studies,  Engineering Mathematics, Engineering Aptitude
															

															Paper II: Engineering Discipline

															
																Type: Objective Type (Multiple Choice Questions)
																Duration: 3 hours
																Marks: 300
																Subjects: Questions are specific to the engineering discipline chosen by the candidate (Civil, Mechanical, Electrical, or Electronics & Telecommunication).
															

															2. Main Examination Pattern:- 

															Paper I: Engineering Discipline

															
																Type: Conventional (Descriptive)
																Duration: 3 hours
																Marks: 300
																Subjects: Detailed questions specific to the chosen engineering discipline.
															

															Paper II: Engineering Discipline

															
																Type: Conventional (Descriptive)
																Duration: 3 hours
																Marks: 300
																Subjects: Further detailed questions specific to the chosen engineering discipline.
															

															3. Interview/Personality Test

															Pattern:

															
																Type: Personal Interview
																Duration: About 200 marks
																Purpose: To assess the candidate’s overall personality, communication skills, and suitability for a career in the engineering services.
															

															Syllabus Overview:-

															Preliminary Examination Syllabus:

															General Studies and Engineering Aptitude:

															
																Current Affairs
																General Science
																Logical Reasoning and Analytical Ability
																Engineering Mathematics
																Basic Engineering Knowledge
															

															Engineering Discipline Paper:

															
																Civil Engineering: Building Materials, Structural Analysis, Concrete Technology, Geotechnical Engineering, Transportation Engineering, Environmental Engineering, etc.
																Mechanical Engineering: Engineering Mechanics, Thermodynamics, Fluid Mechanics, Strength of Materials, Machine Design, Production Engineering, etc.
																Electrical Engineering: Electrical Circuits, Electrical Machines, Power Systems, Control Systems, Electrical and Electronic Measurements, etc.
																Electronics & Telecommunication Engineering: Electronic Devices, Communication Systems, Analog Circuits, Digital Circuits, Signal Processing, etc.
															

															Main Examination Syllabus:

															
																Engineering Discipline Papers:
															

															
																Civil Engineering: Detailed aspects of topics covered in the Preliminary Exam, including advanced concepts and problem-solving.
																Mechanical Engineering: In-depth study of mechanical systems, advanced topics in design, thermodynamics, and manufacturing.
																Electrical Engineering: Advanced topics in electrical systems, machines, power distribution, and control.
																Electronics & Telecommunication Engineering: Advanced electronics, communication theory, and digital systems.
															

															Preparation Tips:

															
																Understand the Syllabus: Thoroughly review the syllabus for both preliminary and main exams.
																Use Standard Textbooks: Refer to standard textbooks and reference materials relevant to your engineering discipline.
																Practice Previous Papers: Solve previous years' question papers to get an idea of the exam pattern and question types.
																Stay Updated: Keep abreast of current affairs and general knowledge topics.
																For the most accurate and detailed syllabus, consult the official UPSC notification and syllabus documents.

															UPSC Engineering Services 2026 Exam Pattern / Syllabus

															1. Preliminary Examination Pattern:-

															Paper I: General Studies and Engineering Aptitude

															
																Type: Objective Type (Multiple Choice Questions)
																Duration: 2 hours
																Marks: 200
																Subjects: General Studies,  Engineering Mathematics, Engineering Aptitude
															

															Paper II: Engineering Discipline

															
																Type: Objective Type (Multiple Choice Questions)
																Duration: 3 hours
																Marks: 300
																Subjects: Questions are specific to the engineering discipline chosen by the candidate (Civil, Mechanical, Electrical, or Electronics & Telecommunication).
															

															2. Main Examination Pattern:- 

															Paper I: Engineering Discipline

															
																Type: Conventional (Descriptive)
																Duration: 3 hours
																Marks: 300
																Subjects: Detailed questions specific to the chosen engineering discipline.
															

															Paper II: Engineering Discipline

															
																Type: Conventional (Descriptive)
																Duration: 3 hours
																Marks: 300
																Subjects: Further detailed questions specific to the chosen engineering discipline.
															

															3. Interview/Personality Test

															Pattern:

															
																Type: Personal Interview
																Duration: About 200 marks
																Purpose: To assess the candidate’s overall personality, communication skills, and suitability for a career in the engineering services.
															

															Syllabus Overview:-

															Preliminary Examination Syllabus:

															General Studies and Engineering Aptitude:

															
																Current Affairs
																General Science
																Logical Reasoning and Analytical Ability
																Engineering Mathematics
																Basic Engineering Knowledge
															

															Engineering Discipline Paper:

															
																Civil Engineering: Building Materials, Structural Analysis, Concrete Technology, Geotechnical Engineering, Transportation Engineering, Environmental Engineering, etc.
																Mechanical Engineering: Engineering Mechanics, Thermodynamics, Fluid Mechanics, Strength of Materials, Machine Design, Production Engineering, etc.
																Electrical Engineering: Electrical Circuits, Electrical Machines, Power Systems, Control Systems, Electrical and Electronic Measurements, etc.
																Electronics & Telecommunication Engineering: Electronic Devices, Communication Systems, Analog Circuits, Digital Circuits, Signal Processing, etc.
															

															Main Examination Syllabus:

															
																Engineering Discipline Papers:
															

															
																Civil Engineering: Detailed aspects of topics covered in the Preliminary Exam, including advanced concepts and problem-solving.
																Mechanical Engineering: In-depth study of mechanical systems, advanced topics in design, thermodynamics, and manufacturing.
																Electrical Engineering: Advanced topics in electrical systems, machines, power distribution, and control.
																Electronics & Telecommunication Engineering: Advanced electronics, communication theory, and digital systems.
															

															Preparation Tips:

															
																Understand the Syllabus: Thoroughly review the syllabus for both preliminary and main exams.
																Use Standard Textbooks: Refer to standard textbooks and reference materials relevant to your engineering discipline.
																Practice Previous Papers: Solve previous years' question papers to get an idea of the exam pattern and question types.
																Stay Updated: Keep abreast of current affairs and general knowledge topics.
																For the most accurate and detailed syllabus, consult the official UPSC notification and syllabus documents.
